Component 1 · Section A · Media Language

Genre & Narrative Lab

Film posters are easy. This lab shows you how to find genre and narrative on magazines, adverts and newspapers too, with three genre and three narrative talking points for every set text.

GENRE = what EVERY one doesThe conventions you’d expect on any magazine cover, advert, newspaper front page or film poster.Ask: “Would I find this on other texts of the same type?”
NARRATIVE = the story THIS one tellsEven a still image tells a story: heroes, mysteries, opposites, a before and an after.Ask: “What story is this text telling, or promising?”
